simple.summary: מַשָּׁאָה (mashshâʼâh) means a loan First listed occurrence: Deut 24 10.

definitions.full: H4859. mashshaah [ מַשָּׁאָה ] noun feminine loan (on pledge); — construct מְאוּמָה מַשַּׁאת בְרֵעֲךָ תַשֶּׁה כִּי Deut 24:10 ; plural מַשָּׁאוֺת עֹרְבִים Prov 22:26 those pledging (giving security for) debts .
